title: Prepare a step-by-step plan for publishing QShopper in an app store
scope: Repository publication is complete. On 2026-11-08 the user selected Google Play with APKs for testing, a new personal developer account and a new production/upload signing setup. Current authorized work prepares the account/release instructions, unsigned production artifacts, size optimization and isolated validation. The user reports the personal account was created on 2026-11-08 and confirmed account verification on 2026-11-12, following the pending identity/address checks. Production key creation, store uploads/submissions and publication have not been performed.

repository_preparation.license_decision: User selected GPL-3.0-or-later for the Qt 6 project. Root LICENSE is the unmodified GNU GPLv3 text; COPYRIGHT states the or-later grant. Third-party terms and the Qt 5 archive's original LGPLv3 license are retained.
repository_preparation.branch_decision: User selected Qt 6 as master and Qt 5 archived as qt5/qshopper, then explicitly requested that the two histories remain separate. Do not create a merge joining those histories.
repository_preparation.local_master_preservation: Old local master's unpublished partial-port commit 9745fce690370883c928323883dd0b7156889474 is preserved under local codex/backup-master-before-qt6. It is not the archived working Qt 5 tip.
repository_preparation.backup: Verified complete pre-promotion Git bundle: out/rel001/before-promotion.bundle. Connectivity check succeeds; dangling objects are not missing history.
repository_preparation.push_plan: Publish qt5/qshopper at the exact old remote master and verify it first. Then publish the current Qt 6 tree to master and qt6/qshopper, using an explicit master lease for the expected old tip and an atomic multi-ref push where supported. Never overwrite an unexpected remote update.
repository_preparation.authentication: Dedicated repository SSH deploy key accepted by GitHub with write access. The local per-PC Git configuration selects it and a host key pinned to GitHub's published Ed25519 fingerprint. Private credentials stay outside the repository.
repository_preparation.verification: Root GPL text matches the official GNU download, local Markdown links and PNG files validate, both native app screenshots were visually inspected, no application sources changed, and the verified pre-promotion bundle preserves all original refs. Root Git connectivity check succeeds.
repository_preparation.publication_result: Qt 5 archive was published and read back before the atomic, lease-protected master/development update. GitHub serves the new README, exact GNU GPL text and both screenshots. Default branch remains master. git merge-base confirms master and qt5/qshopper have no common ancestor; no history-joining merge was created.
repository_preparation.transport: Origin retains its SSH URL. This checkout uses the dedicated deploy key over GitHub's documented ssh.github.com:443 endpoint, with strict host checking against the published Ed25519 key; port 22 was intermittently unavailable.
repository_preparation.status: Repository publication complete and verified. Broader store planning/signing/distribution work remains open; this does not close REL-001.

request: Prepare the app for app-store publication and define the steps needed to publish it.
expected: A practical release checklist and preparation plan with dependencies, required user decisions, acceptance criteria, and a clear path from the current development build to a store release.
planning_steps: Google Play and a new personal developer account are confirmed. Follow RELEASE.md for account/physical-device verification; owner choices for audience, countries, languages, pricing and public contacts remain.
Check the selected store's current official requirements at implementation time, recording sources and dates rather than treating this backlog as a fixed policy checklist.
Agree release readiness criteria and identify blocking bugs, missing behavior, and validation work from the existing backlog, including critical right-swipe behavior and comprehensive UI coverage.

Define a reproducible production Release build and required store artifact, including package identity, version name/code progression, SDK/ABI requirements, dependency packaging, and disabled development-only behavior.

Define production signing and key backup/ownership. Distinguish the current debug keystore from any required upload/app-signing keys and plan the transition from existing debug installations without assuming signing compatibility.

Test clean installation, updates, persistence, representative devices, native keyboard/Back gestures, safe areas, accessibility, and release-specific behavior using isolated test data where appropriate.

Audit permissions, data handling, backup behavior, third-party dependencies, and applicable licensing/privacy obligations; prepare the selected store's required declarations and supporting policy materials based on actual app behavior.
Prepare store-listing assets and text: app name/description, icon, screenshots and any other required imagery, category, support/contact information, and localization as applicable.
Define internal/closed testing and review/submission steps appropriate to the store/account, followed by user-approved production rollout and a monitoring/support plan.
Document release tagging/artifact retention, future update procedures, and what to do if a release needs to be halted or corrected.
implementation_notes: Keep the process KISS: a concise, repeatable checklist supported by necessary scripts, not an elaborate release framework.
Reuse ANDROID.md, build-android.ps1, the verification workflow, and existing tickets rather than duplicating build or bug-tracking instructions.
Record unknown account-specific requirements and user decisions explicitly instead of inventing account access, completed verification, or policy compliance.
Do not commit signing secrets or store credentials. Define the release-key handling process before producing publication artifacts.
Separate readiness analysis, approved preparation changes, store submission, and actual publication so each step has concrete evidence and appropriate user authorization.

Historical DEV-011 added Qt Canvas Painter / QtCanvas2D. DEV-008 subsequently removed that runtime payload. Review the actual final artifact inventory, including JNI/Maven dependencies, against notices and corresponding-source arrangements; do not treat the old Canvas observation as a current dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Create a publication checklist with ordered steps, dependencies, required inputs/decisions, and evidence required to finish each step.
Confirm target store/account assumptions and cite current official requirements relevant to the selected publication path.
Identify the gap between the existing debug build workflow and a reproducible signed production release.
Define readiness checks and link unresolved release blockers to their backlog tickets rather than claiming the app is ready prematurely.
List required store assets, declarations, testing/review stages, and rollout/update procedures.
Keep actual account actions, uploads, submissions, and publication outside this planning task unless separately authorized by the user.
evidence: Explicit user backlog request on 2026-10-28 to prepare and define the steps for app-store publication.

release_preparation.profile: MinSizeRel (-Os), native ThinLTO, R8/resource shrinking, retained Qt JNI/bootstrap resources. Debug workflow unchanged. Android code advances from 2 to 3; version name stays 0.1.0.

release_preparation.library_selection: android/runtime-libraries.txt records the 40 required Release libraries. All 13 Qt-declared optional QML wrappers were removed cumulatively and exercised on native Android; final combination passes. Removing a required Material plugin intentionally fails the same harness. Native backing modules remain because of actual ELF dependencies.
release_preparation.packaging: Standalone APK compresses native libraries for the smallest file, trading extraction and installed storage. AAB uses independent uncompressed, 16 KB-aligned Play native splits. Actual device-targeted splits retain all 40 libraries and pass native interactions; universal bundletool output is not used to infer split layout.

regression.artifact_tests: tests/test_android_release.py plus tests/test_android_package.py: original 53-library payload fails the minimal inventory contract; Debug is rejected as Release. Final ARM64/x86_64 APK and AAB metadata, dependency closure, exact inventory, stripped runtime, ELF 16 KB alignment, ZIP alignment/bundle config pass.
regression.native_tests: tests/android/test_optional_plugins.py and tests/android/test_release.py: actual non-debuggable standalone and device-targeted split installs pass native entry, drawer/theme/selectors, both offline notices, delete/Undo, exact text and cold restart. Same-key Debug code 2 to Release code 3 update preserves item text and Light theme.
regression.isolation: Fresh temporary emulator userdata/cache on emulator-5580, no normal emulator or phone data used. Genuine Release ignores Qt debug environment extras and denies run-as; tests require --disposable-device and only accept emulator serials.
regression.compatibility: Default ARM64 Debug shared-key build/package verification and Windows configure/build/model tests pass. No application QML/C++ behavior changed in this release-preparation step.

ordered_scope: Audit application and bundled Android dependencies, local database/settings, backup behavior, keyboard dictation and actual manifest permissions. Record what can leave the device and under whose control.

Remove permissions confirmed unnecessary using the supported deployment/manifest mechanism, with a failing-before/passing-after APK permission regression and affected native behavior checks. Do not remove needed Qt backing libraries.

Add readable in-app policy access consistent with the drawer and Back behavior. Cover opening/closing, readable content, offline availability if bundled, and retained draft/list state with automated regression tests.
Prepare the public policy page for owner review and the chosen hosting destination. Publication, Console declarations and submissions require their own authorized action.

versioning.request: User asked to start app versioning.
versioning.policy: Start at development version 0.1.0 / Android code 2. Root CMake owns both runtime/name and increasing Android update code. Patch increments for fixes, minor increments for features/behavior changes before 1.0.0. Tag only an accepted tested release; no tag or release has been published by this change.
versioning.verification: Release/Debug runtime-version check and both APK metadata tests agree with CMake; native package-manager probe reports 0.1.0 (2). README Versions section documents the policy.
